column2: Add the finely chopped greens and pepper to the cooled lentils.
Toss with lemon juice and olive oil.
Let rest briefly before serving.
Yeasted açma rolls
4 cups flour
1 cup lukewarm milk
1 tablespoon dry yeast
1 tablespoon sugar
Mix the lukewarm milk, yeast and sugar and leave for 10 minutes.
Add the flour and oil, knead a soft dough and let rise for 45 minutes.
Shape the dough into strips and place on a tray.
Brush with egg and bake at 190 °C until golden.
Orzo pilaf with tomato
Add the grated tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.
Add the hot water and put the lid on.
When the water is absorbed over low heat, let rest and serve.
Bulgur pilaf with mushrooms
Sauté the onion in oil and add the mushrooms.
Stir in the bulgur and add the hot water.
Cook covered over low heat until the water is absorbed.
Chicken erişte (egg noodles)
Cut the chicken small and cook it through in oil.
Add the chopped pepper and soften it.
Stir in the erişte and toast briefly.
Add hot water and cook until the erişte is soft.
Tomato pasta with basil
6 basil leaves
Briefly sauté the garlic in olive oil and add the grated tomato.
Cook until the sauce thickens.
Mix the pasta with the sauce and chopped basil.
Shrimp casserole
300 g cleaned shrimp
Half a cup kashar cheese
Soften the garlic and pepper in butter.
Add the tomatoes and cook until it reaches a sauce consistency.
Add the shrimp and stir briefly until fully cooked.
Transfer to a casserole dish, add kashar and brown in the oven.
Baked curry chicken
1 dessert spoon curry
Mix the yogurt, curry and oil.
Coat the chicken with the sauce and leave in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Place in a baking dish together with the peppers.
Bake at 190 °C until the chicken is fully cooked.
Chicken vegetable soup
Cook the chicken through in water and break it into small pieces.
Add the chopped vegetables to the chicken stock.
When the vegetables are soft, return the chicken pieces.
Simmer together for a few minutes and serve.
Cream-free mushroom soup
Soften the onion in oil and add the sliced mushrooms.
Stir in the flour and toast briefly.
Pour in the water gradually while stirring.
When the mushrooms are cooked, add the milk and simmer a few more minutes.
Pumpkin soup
400 g pumpkin
Add the diced pumpkin, potato and carrot.
Simmer in water until the vegetables are completely soft.
Blend and serve hot.
Pumpkin dessert with tahini
600 g pumpkin
3 tablespoons crushed walnuts
Cut the pumpkin into large cubes and layer with sugar in a pot.
Add the water and cook over low heat until soft.
Transfer the cooled pumpkin to a serving plate.
Drizzle with tahini and sprinkle with walnuts.
Orange cake
Grated zest of 1 orange
Beat the eggs and sugar until frothy.
Add the milk, oil and orange zest.
Mix in the flour and baking powder and pour into the tin.
Bake at 175 °C for about 35 minutes until cooked in the middle.
Baked semolina milk pudding
8 tablespoons semolina
6 tablespoons sugar
Thicken the milk, semolina and sugar in a pot, stirring constantly.
Add the vanilla and butter.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish.
Bake at 200 °C until lightly coloured on top.
Breakfast eggs with potatoes
Cut the potatoes into small cubes.
Cook covered in oil until soft.
Add the beaten eggs and spices.
Stir until the eggs are fully cooked.
Quinoa vegetable bowl
1 avocado
Rinse the quinoa well and cook in twice its volume of water until soft.
Chop the cucumber, pepper and avocado.
Combine the cooled quinoa with the vegetables.
Add lemon juice and olive oil and mix.
Spiced oven potatoes
1 teaspoon sweet paprika
Cut the potatoes, skin on or peeled, into wedges.
Toss with the oil and spices.
Arrange in a single layer on a tray lined with baking paper.
Bake at 200 °C until golden outside and soft inside.
Orzo pilaf with vegetables
Chop the carrot and pepper small.
Toast the orzo in oil until lightly coloured.
Add the vegetables and stir for two minutes.
Add the hot water and cook over low heat until absorbed.
Beetroot salad with yogurt
4 tablespoons yogurt
Mix with the yogurt and crushed garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve.
Lemon chicken drumsticks
Preheat the oven to 190 degrees.
Mix the lemon juice, oil, crushed garlic and thyme.
Coat the drumsticks with the sauce and place in a baking dish.
Bake for about 40-45 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked inside.
Baked zucchini slices
1 teaspoon dried mint
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.
Slice the zucchini to an even thickness.
Mix with the oil and spices and arrange in a single layer.
Bake until the edges are golden and the insides soft.
Tomato and cheese pasta
1 teaspoon basil
Boil the pasta according to the packet instructions and drain.
Grate the tomatoes and cook them in oil until the liquid has reduced a little.
Add the pasta to the sauce and mix.
Serve with crumbled cheese and basil.
Roasted pepper yogurt meze
3 red kapia peppers
5 tablespoons yogurt
Roast the peppers in the oven or in a pan.
Let them rest in a covered container and peel off the skins.
Chop small and mix with the yogurt and garlic.
Leeks with potatoes
3 leeks
Wash the leeks thoroughly and cut into rings.
Dice the potato and carrot.
Stir the vegetables in oil for a few minutes.
Add the water and cook covered until the vegetables are soft.
Carrot salad with orange
3 carrots
1 orange
Peel and grate the carrots.
Peel the orange, remove the white pith and slice.
Mix the olive oil and lemon juice.
Toss the carrot and orange with the dressing.
Baked mushrooms with cheese
12 large mushrooms
Clean the mushrooms and remove the stems.
Arrange on a tray and put a little oil and cheese inside each.
Bake until the mushrooms soften and the cheese melts.
Couscous with vegetables
Boil the couscous according to the packet instructions.
Cut the zucchini and carrot into small cubes.
Sauté the vegetables in olive oil until soft.
Combine with the drained couscous and serve hot.
Lemon lentil salad
2 spring onions
Wash the lentils, boil them without letting them fall apart, and drain.
Finely chop the spring onion and parsley.
Mix the lentils with the greens.
Dress with lemon juice and olive oil.
Baked pear dessert
3 ripe pears
2 tablespoons coarsely ground walnuts
2 tablespoons water
